description: Turn every airfield and mobile carrier into an in-cockpit navigation destination. A searchable, faction-aware panel shows bearing, range, runway courses, ground speed, ETA, and elevation, while heading-tape cues and a VOR-style CDI provide direct-to guidance or manual-course tracking. Includes nearest/name sorting, friendly-only filtering, a position-adjustable HUD, and configurable hotkeys. Supports NO Mod Bar for one-click access to the navigation panel.
